in_sanskrit.name: Bibhuti
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Bibhuti is derived from the Sanskrit root 'bibhuh', which means 'auspiciousness, prosperity, fortune'. The name itself means 'auspiciousness, prosperity, fortune, sacred substance'.

in_hindi.name: बिभुति
in_hindi.long_meaning: संस्कृत आकर्द्द्षिक्य 'बिभुह' से उत्पन्न हुआ नाम 'बिभुति' के मेमिंग है 'शुभता, सफलता, धन'।

in_marathi.name: Bibhuti
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Auspicious, Divine Substance
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bibhuti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bibhuti is a Sanskrit word derived from the root bibhuh meaning 'auspicious' or 'divine substance'. In Hindu mythology, Bibhuti is a sacred substance made from the ashes of sacred fires, used in religious rituals and ceremonies. It represents purity, auspiciousness, and the presence of the divine.
